component_ids_and_models: CPU: DS3_CPU_001 (Ryzen 7 5700X3D) | Cooler: cooler-cm-hyper-212-black (Hyper 212 Black) | Motherboard: DS3_MB_084 (Gigabyte B550 EAGLE WIFI6) | RAM: DS3_RAM_001 (Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB DDR4-3200) | GPU: DS3_GPU_005 (XFX RX 6600 8GB) | Storage: DS3_STORAGE_040 (Samsung 970 Evo Plus 500GB) | PSU: DS3_PSU_001 (MSI MAG A550BN 550W) | Case: case-pop-air-mini (Fractal Pop Air Mini)
individual_compatibility_findings: CPU+MB: AM4 socket matches; requires BIOS F16+ for 5700X3D support. RAM+MB: DDR4-3200 matches. MB+Case: ATX motherboard in mATX case collision! Wait: DS3_MB_084 is ATX (Gigabyte B550 Eagle is ATX), Pop Air Mini is mATX!
blocking_issues: Form factor mismatch: Gigabyte B550 EAGLE is standard ATX; Fractal Pop Air Mini only accepts mATX/ITX boards.
conditions: Replace case with standard ATX chassis (e.g. H7 Flow or 4000D) or replace board with mATX (e.g. B550M DS3H).

conditions: Install Gen5 SSD with motherboard heavy heatsink; enable XMP profile.

component_ids_and_models: CPU: cpu-r5-9600x (Ryzen 5 9600X, AM5) | Cooler: cooler-deepcool-ak400-black | Motherboard: DS3_MB_085 (MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4, LGA1700) | RAM: ram-ddr5-32gb-6000 (DDR5) | GPU: DS3_GPU_049 (MSI RTX 4070 SUPER) | Storage: ssd-sn850x-2tb | PSU: psu-750w-gold | Case: case-h7-flow
individual_compatibility_findings: CPU+MB: Socket conflict (AM5 PGA/LGA package cannot insert into Intel LGA1700 socket). RAM+MB: Memory technology conflict (DDR5 RAM kit cannot fit into DDR4 DIMM slots on H610 motherboard).
blocking_issues: Socket mismatch (AM5 vs LGA1700) and RAM standard mismatch (DDR5 vs DDR4).
conditions: Unresolvable without replacing motherboard with an AM5 DDR5 board.

component_ids_and_models: CPU: cpu-r7-7800x3d (Ryzen 7 7800X3D) | Cooler: cooler-deepcool-ak400-black | Motherboard: mb-b650-tomahawk (ATX) | RAM: ram-ddr5-32gb-6000 | GPU: gpu-nvidia-asus-rog-astral-rtx5090-o32g (Length 358mm) | Storage: ssd-sn850x-2tb | PSU: psu-1000w-plat | Case: case-meshify-2 (Fractal Meshify 2 Compact, Max GPU 341mm)
individual_compatibility_findings: GPU+Case: Physical clearance conflict. GPU card length is 358mm; case maximum clearance with front fan is 341mm. GPU exceeds clearance by 17mm and collides with chassis front fan frame.
blocking_issues: GPU physical length exceeds maximum chassis clearance.
conditions: Requires replacing chassis with longer mid-tower (e.g. H7 Flow, 410mm clearance).

component_ids_and_models: CPU: cpu-r5-9600x | Cooler: cooler-cm-hyper-212-black | Motherboard: mb-b650-tomahawk (ATX 305mm) | RAM: ram-ddr5-32gb-6000 | GPU: DS3_GPU_005 (XFX RX 6600 8GB) | Storage: ssd-sn850x-2tb | PSU: psu-750w-gold | Case: case-pop-air-mini (Micro-ATX chassis)
individual_compatibility_findings: Motherboard+Case: Form factor conflict. Motherboard is full-size ATX (305mm vertical height). Fractal Pop Air Mini chassis interior only accommodates micro-ATX (244mm) and mini-ITX motherboards.
blocking_issues: ATX motherboard cannot install in micro-ATX chassis; standoffs and expansion brackets misaligned.
conditions: Replace case with ATX chassis or replace board with mATX AM5 board.

component_ids_and_models: CPU: cpu-intel-core-i9-14900k (253W PL2) | Cooler: DS3_COOLER_002 (ARCTIC Liquid Freezer III 360) | Motherboard: DS3_MB_002 (ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z790 HERO) | RAM: ram-ddr5-64gb-6000 | GPU: DS3_GPU_036 (ASUS ROG Strix RTX 4090 24GB, 500W VBIOS) | Storage: ssd-sn850x-4tb | PSU: DS3_PSU_001 (MSI MAG A550BN 550W Bronze) | Case: case-h7-flow
individual_compatibility_findings: PSU+System: Catastrophic power deficit. Combined system power under load is ~750W-850W with transient spikes >1000W. 550W Bronze PSU will immediately trigger Over-Power Protection (OPP) and shutdown, and lacks required 12VHPWR / multi-PCIe cables.
blocking_issues: PSU wattage is 450W below ASUS 1000W system requirement; severe fire/shutdown hazard.
conditions: Must upgrade PSU to 1000W+ ATX 3.0/3.1 Gold/Platinum unit.

component_ids_and_models: CPU: DS3_CPU_034 (AMD Ryzen 9 5900X, no iGPU) | Cooler: cooler-deepcool-ak400-black | Motherboard: DS3_MB_084 (Gigabyte B550 EAGLE WIFI6) | RAM: DS3_RAM_001 (16GB DDR4) | GPU: NONE (No Discrete GPU) | Storage: DS3_STORAGE_040 (Samsung 970 Evo Plus) | PSU: DS3_PSU_001 (MSI 550W) | Case: case-h7-flow
individual_compatibility_findings: Display Output: Missing display controller. AMD Ryzen 9 5900X has no integrated graphics processor. Motherboard display outputs are unpowered. System cannot POST or display video without a discrete GPU.
blocking_issues: Zero display output capabilities in system.
conditions: Add a discrete graphics card or switch CPU to an APU (e.g. Ryzen 5 5600G).

component_ids_and_models: CPU: cpu-intel-core-i9-14900k (253W PL2) | Cooler: DS3_COOLER_025 (Noctua NH-L9x65 65mm) | Motherboard: DS3_MB_002 (ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z790 HERO) | RAM: ram-ddr5-32gb-6000 | GPU: DS3_GPU_049 (MSI RTX 4070 SUPER) | Storage: ssd-sn850x-2tb | PSU: psu-850w-gold | Case: case-h7-flow
individual_compatibility_findings: Cooler+CPU: Thermal inadequacy. Noctua explicitly rates NH-L9x65 as incapable of dissipating 253W PL2 thermal load. CPU will hit 100C thermal junction throttle point within seconds, dropping clock speeds below base.
blocking_issues: Thermal dissipation failure; cooler inadequate for processor power envelope.
conditions: Replace with 360mm AIO liquid cooler or flagship dual-tower air cooler (e.g. NH-D15 / PA120).

component_ids_and_models: CPU: DS3_CPU_046 (Intel Core i9-12900K) | Cooler: cooler-deepcool-ak400-black | Motherboard: DS3_MB_085 (MSI PRO H610M-G DDR4) | RAM: DS3_RAM_001 (Corsair DDR4-3200 16GB) | GPU: DS3_GPU_005 (XFX RX 6600 8GB) | Storage: DS3_STORAGE_040 (Samsung 970 Evo Plus 500GB) | PSU: DS3_PSU_001 (MSI 550W Bronze) | Case: case-corsair-frame-4000d-rs-argb
individual_compatibility_findings: CPU+MB: 12th Gen Alder Lake native on H610. RAM+MB: DDR4 matching. GPU+Case: 241mm in 430mm case. MB+Case: mATX board fits ATX case. PSU+System: 550W is sufficient for gaming (~300W total), but 12900K all-core load (241W) will trigger VRM throttling on budget H610.

component_ids_and_models: CPU: cpu-intel-core-ultra-9-285k (Core Ultra 9 285K) | Cooler: cooler-cm-hyper-212-black | Motherboard: mb-z890-tomahawk (MSI Z890 Tomahawk, DDR5) | RAM: DS3_RAM_001 (Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB DDR4-3200) | GPU: DS3_GPU_049 (MSI RTX 4070 SUPER) | Storage: ssd-sn850x-2tb | PSU: psu-750w-gold | Case: case-h7-flow
individual_compatibility_findings: RAM+MB: Physical DIMM slot conflict. Intel Z890 motherboard features DDR5 DIMM slots exclusively. DDR4 RAM module has incompatible pin pitch and key notch, and cannot be physically inserted.
blocking_issues: DDR4 memory module incompatible with DDR5-exclusive Z890 motherboard and Arrow Lake platform.
conditions: Must replace RAM kit with DDR5 memory (e.g. DDR5-6000).
